messages.author: decdbce2df380025
messages.subject: Data file input
parts:
Dear Shiny Team,

I have developed an app that runs on glimmer. To run this app, users need to upload a file containing their data (handled now using fileInput), the data is analyzed, and plots and results are generated.
I would like to know what happens to the datafile uploaded by the user? Is it possible for us to incorporate some code in server.R so that the uploaded file is removed, say once the user is done with the analysis?

Thank you very much for the development of Shiny!

Regards,
Jyothi

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Data file input
parts: These are currently just stored as temp files so they are usually cleaned up when the app's R process exits. It would be great to have the files cleaned up when the user leaves, though--I think we can add that.
